name: Yara
who: Keeps eleven beehives on her family's land outside Amman. No use case fits her: she wants her own lists, in her own words, for the hives and what she finds in each.
said: I'm Yara. I keep eleven beehives and want to log inspections and honey per hive.

says.plain: I'm Yara. I keep eleven beehives and want to log inspections and honey per hive.
says.hard: I'm Yara. Eleven boxes at the bottom of the garden, and I never remember which one I opened last.

first: Hive 4 inspected, queen seen, 6 frames of brood

said: Hive 7 inspected, no queen seen, add a frame of eggs
Hive 2 inspected, calm, 4 kg honey taken
